entities.summary: Khvicha Kvaratskhelia is a Georgian professional footballer who plays as a left winger for Ligue 1 club Paris Saint-Germain and captains the Georgia national team. Regarded as one of the best players in the world and as one of the greatest Georgian players of all time, he is known for his dribbling, agility, and playmaking.
